title: Hinomori Shizuku — What I Want To Become〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Today, as part of our video-making process, we'll be watching different videos on various sites to see what we can learn from them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're starting with the idol-related videos first, right? I have a feeling there's going to be so many of them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Let's all search for some videos now♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I need to contribute too. Let's see...
To search for videos, I tap here and...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hm? It's not working...
Hello...? Mr. Smartphone?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh... You and electronics really don't get along, huh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, hold up! You haven't even opened any video sites yet!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here! To search for a video, tap here. Then you enter a keyword in the search bar and press the search button.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I get it now. Let me try it out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, but what should I be searching for?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good question. If we all used the same keywords, we'll just end up finding the same things...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How about you just try whatever comes to mind first when you think about idol-related stuff?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Idol-related stuff... Ah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe. For me, that would be...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh my! This is amazing!
Look at this, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What is it? You found something good?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! Here, look at this.

rows.Speaker: Video Airi
rows.Line: <How's everyone doing♪ The Masked Variety Idol, Happy Everyday, is here to make☆your☆day!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait a minute!
What on earth were you searching for?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? I just searched for Happy Everyday...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's not what I was asking!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, this show... I've heard about it, but this is my first time actually seeing it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I watched it every week! Airi was always so cool whenever she was on it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But this won't help us at all, so we don't need to watch it! Plus, it's gotta be a terms of service violation, so I'm gonna report it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sigh... Why am I so tired after just searching for videos online...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hey, everyone. Look at this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, the Can It Be Done in Three Minutes ☆ Series?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. This is the part where rookie idols are faced with all sorts of challenges...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How they handle or complete a challenge reveals what they're really like and it's really interesting to watch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Aside from singing and dancing, these kinds of segments might also make our videos more enjoyable for both ourselves and our viewers.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's true!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, this is good.
Let's keep looking for more we can use.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course...

rows.Speaker: Video Airi
rows.Line: <How's everyone doing♪ The Masked Variety Idol, Happy Everyday, is here to make☆your☆day!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, stop that!
Why are you playing it again?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's strange. I did stop the it but...
Let's see... Stop.

rows.Speaker: Video Airi
rows.Line: <How's everyone doing♪ The Masked Variety Idol, Happy Everyday, is here to make☆your☆day!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What're you doing? Come on, give it here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Don't worry. I think I just have to press this one instead. There...!

rows.Speaker: Video Airi
rows.Line: <How's everyone doing♪ The Masked Variety Idol, Happy Everyday, is here to make☆your☆day!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Enough! Just give it here already!
